subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should OpenClaw expose operator-authored `agents.list[].description` values through `agents_list` as core runtime/tool output, or keep the field as config metadata only?
rationale: This is an additive config and model-visible tool-output surface; current main only implements config acceptance, while the open linked PR owns runtime exposure.

options.title: Land bounded agents_list descriptions
options.body: Review and, if acceptable, land the open linked PR so `agents_list` returns bounded nonblank configured descriptions.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Reject runtime exposure and close the linked PR if maintainers decide prompt/tool-output growth is not desirable in core.

recommendation.title: Land bounded agents_list descriptions
recommendation.body: Review and, if acceptable, land the open linked PR so `agents_list` returns bounded nonblank configured descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool and has already provided maintainer-facing context on this exact issue.
